field.warrantyHint: The warranty counts from the day the battery was first fitted.
field.odometerMissing: Without the odometer we cannot tell how far the battery ran.
field.odometerBackwards: This is below the odometer at fitting ({{km}}) — check the number

picker.notListed: Not listed? Add a new type
picker.newTitle: A battery type not on the list
picker.newHint: Enter the brand, Ah and volts as written on the battery. The type is added to the list by itself.

bay.underOpenWo: Batteries fitted or taken off here are recorded under the truck's open work order.
bay.noOpenWo: Fitting a battery is recorded inside an open work order, and this truck has none right now — open one above. Registering a battery that is already on the truck, or taking one off, needs no work order.

fit.title: Fit a battery in slot {{n}}
fit.subtitle: It is recorded under the work order, and the battery due date starts again.
fit.notStocked: This type is not in stock — it is fitted anyway; correct the stock with a count later.
fit.zeroStock: Stock says there are none of this type — it is fitted anyway; check the count later.
fit.noUsedHow: A battery taken off and put back in stock, or back from charging, shows up here.

register.title: Register the battery in slot {{n}}
register.subtitle: For a battery that was on the truck before the app: it is not taken from stock and does not change the due date — it is only written down.

remove.title: Take the battery off slot {{n}}
remove.suggested: We picked the usual place for that reason — change it if it is wrong.
remove.underWo: Recorded under the open work order.
remove.noWo: No open work order — the removal is recorded without one.
remove.pickFirst: Choose the reason and the place first.
remove.submitScrap: Take it off and scrap it

done.in_stock_used: Battery taken off and back in stock
done.charging: Battery taken off and sent for charging
done.warranty: Battery taken off and sent for warranty

edit.title: Edit battery details
edit.typeHint: The type (brand, Ah) is not edited here: if the type is wrong, undo the fitting and fit the right one.

undoFit.title: Undo this fitting?
undoFit.body: For a wrong battery or a wrong slot. The battery leaves slot {{n}} as if it was never fitted: a new one goes back to stock, a used one back to used stock, and a battery that was only registered is deleted.

undoRemoval.title: Put the battery back?
undoRemoval.body: The battery goes back into slot {{n}} as if it was never taken off — for a removal made by mistake.

slots.title: Battery slots on this truck
slots.hint: Most trucks have two. Add more if this one has more.
slots.inUse: It cannot go below the highest slot with a battery in it — take that one off first.

removed.title: Batteries taken off this truck
removed.empty: No battery has been taken off this truck yet

history.title: Battery history
history.empty: This battery has not been fitted to any truck yet

wo.title: Batteries
wo.empty: No battery work in this work order

page.title: Batteries
page.subtitle: Every battery has a record: which truck it is on, how far it ran, and how long its warranty lasts.
page.empty: No batteries recorded yet. A battery is recorded when it is fitted from stock, or from a truck's page with "Register the one already here".
